note: All four message kinds asserted at the receiver and the composer: a Nak Response carrying a desired-Type list ends the exchange with EAP-Failure and reaches no method (recording/tap method sees nothing), Success and Failure encode to their four octets, the peer's Notification Response carries zero octets of Type-Data, ze's authenticator sends no Notification Request, and an injected Notification carrying MS-CHAPv2 result bytes does not advance the method.
